items.headline: Sesko forced to withdraw from international break with injury setback
items.summary: Benjamin Sesko missed Fulham game after suffering setback in Carabao Cup loss to Brighton. Latest injury may be recurrence of chronic issue with no clear return date.

items.headline: United decision to avoid striker signing tested by Sesko fitness concerns
items.summary: Manchester United's choice not to add backup striker in summer window being exposed by Benjamin Sesko's injury struggles, forcing Carrick to operate without recognised senior striker.
